I am a second-year D.Eng student at Penn State’s School of Engineering Design and Innovation, with research focused on engineered systems for simulating and evaluating market and non-market economic impacts.

I currently work in Applied Sciences (Data Science) at Bayer and bring more than 10 years of experience across agriculture, aviation, consulting, analytics, and applied R&D.

This site highlights my current research, teaching materials, and selected projects.
